All four reviewer defects plus both minors are resolved: shapes normalised via _unwrap(); the duplicate guard now reads fallbacks off live directly; the diff is SCOPED to the keys the write intended, with untouched live keys reported rather than failed; _last_json_object() takes the last TOP-LEVEL object, advancing past each one so it cannot descend into nested {"source": ...} elements (the first attempt at this fix still failed the piped form for exactly that reason); the unused LITELLM_MASTER_KEY gate is gone; --expected is parsed positionally-safely. BLOCKS PR #140 / TASK 136 - do this before that merge. (2) the duplicate guard inherits it - live.get("router_settings", {}) is always {} so dup_ok is ALWAYS False regardless of the DB; (3) even once fixed the diff is UNSCOPED - the intended body holds only `fallbacks` so every other live key (routing_strategy, num_retries, timeout, retry_after, allowed_fails, cooldown_time, allowed_fails_policy.*, context_window_fallbacks) reports as extra_keys, and the docstring claims it verifies 'no other key changed' with NO baseline to diff against - either scope the diff to fallbacks only or take a pre-write baseline; drop the gate or make the comment honest); and --expected parsing blindly indexes sys.argv[1:][1], so passing it after any other flag silently grabs the wrong token. *** CONFIRMED CORRECT - DO NOT REFACTOR: prepare.py idempotence (re-fetches the live row, appends only groups whose source is absent, second run adds nothing);
